answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 35053 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to wear black clothes? Question: Is it permissible to wear black clothes? Answer ID: 35053 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1675/1675/M=1432) It is lawful for women without karahat; also there is no harm for male to wear it. However it becomes the sign of Shia in the month of Muharram; hence it is better to avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
